spans.s:
f. (-द्धिः)
Ignorance.
mfn. (-द्धिः-द्धिः-द्धि)
Ignorant, stupid.
E.
अ neg. बुद्धि understanding.

mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्)
Unwise, ignorant, foolish.
E.
अ neg. बुद्धिमत् wise.

mfn. (-धः-धा-धं)
Stupid, foolish. a fool.
E.
अ neg. बुध wise.

m. (-त्तः)
A sister's husband, (in theatrical language.)
E.
आप to obtain, क्विप्, उत् and तन् to stretch, ड affix, प is changed to ब; according to another etymology the word is आवुत्त.
